description:
Plan the storyboard: every segment, its timing, image and motion
prompts, overlays and continuations, following the channel style and
any `[SCENE: ...]` directions. Needs the finished voiceover (its timing
drives the cuts). It plans images, plus real photos and B-roll when the
director style has the `@real-media` tag; clips come later, by animating
rendered images. Running it again replaces the whole plan, edits
included. The longest step (several minutes): get_status wait=true,
repeatedly.

editable_sections.description: Template prompt section overrides, keyed by section id
